status: analysis exploration lock; not a model; no version assigned
finalHorseScore: market log probability plus strict-OOS LambdaRank residual raw score
jointDistribution: Plackett-Luce over all active runners in the race using exp(finalHorseScore)

ticketProbabilities.quinella: sum of both ordered top-two Plackett-Luce probabilities
ticketProbabilities.wide: sum of all ordered top-three Plackett-Luce outcomes containing both horses

ticketScore: joint probability multiplied by JRA official odds; wide uses official lower bound
nextStageOnlyIfUseful: five-race selection and exact Light allocation must be locked separately before portfolio ROI evaluation
